## 4. PTO and Expense Policy (~300 lines)

Before you ship it, three things are worth a quick look. None requires a redesign:

1. **The description is the weak point.** Claude decides whether to load a skill from that one line. "Anything related to our company" gives it nothing to match on, so the skill may trigger on unrelated questions or miss specific ones. A one-line fix that keeps the single-file plan:
   `description: Company reference for engineering (Python/TypeScript style, deploys and rollbacks for our 4 services, on-call alert runbook), HR (PTO, expenses), marketing brand voice, org chart and contacts, and internal glossary. Use when a task touches any of these.`

2. **All ~3,000 lines load every time the skill triggers.** A question about PTO will also pull in the on-call runbook and code style. That costs context and can dilute attention. If it becomes a problem later, the section headings above split cleanly into separate files that SKILL.md could link to, and it's still one place to maintain.

3. **The org chart has names and phone numbers.** Skill files are often committed to repos or shared. Confirm that's an acceptable place for personal contact details, or link to the directory instead of pasting it.

I can draft the combined description or fill in any section's body if you'd like.
